answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can trade: a newcomer must complete small, costly attestations over time, like a comet leaving a long observable trail, while peers cross-check its record against a shared atlas of reputations. A juniper-style rotating audit then samples agents at random; fakes copying one identity cannot afford the stake, time, and consistent history across many clones, so sybils become unprofitable.
